SSC MTS Havaldar Result 2026 Out: Merit List PDF, Cut-Off Marks & Result Link

Last Updated: 3 August 2026

The Staff Selection Commission (SSC) has declared the SSC MTS Havaldar Result 2026 for the Computer-Based Examination conducted under the Multi-Tasking (Non-Technical) Staff and Havaldar (CBIC & CBN) Examination, 2025. Candidates who appeared in the examination can check the result and qualifying status through the official SSC website.

The SSC MTS and Havaldar examination was conducted in February 2026. The result is published in PDF format, while the cut-off is determined according to the applicable post, category, State/UT/CCA and, for MTS, the relevant age group. Candidates shortlisted for the Havaldar post will have to qualify the PET/PST, whereas further selection for MTS is governed by the merit and allocation provisions specified by SSC.

Candidates should use only the official SSC portal and result documents while checking their qualifying status, cut-off and subsequent selection instructions.

Latest Update

SSC MTS Result 2026 has been released on 3 August 2026 for the Multi-Tasking (Non-Technical) Staff and Havaldar (CBIC & CBN) Examination, 2025. The official cut-off has also been released with the result. Candidates should check the SSC result section for the result/write-up PDF and subsequent notices.

SSC MTS Result 2026 Download

Candidates can check the SSC MTS Result 2026 PDF through the result section of the Staff Selection Commission website.

The result document should be treated as the authoritative source for determining whether a candidate has been shortlisted. Candidates are advised not to rely on screenshots, social-media messages or unofficial merit lists.

"SSC Official Website" (https://reference-url-citation.invalid/4)

How to Check SSC MTS Havaldar Result 2026

1. Visit the official Staff Selection Commission website.

2. Open the Result section from the SSC portal.

3. Find the result notice for the Multi-Tasking (Non-Technical) Staff and Havaldar (CBIC & CBN) Examination, 2025.

4. Open/download the relevant result PDF.

5. Use the PDF search function (Ctrl+F on a computer) and enter your roll number or name, where applicable.

6. Check your qualifying status carefully.

7. Download and retain the result/write-up for future reference.

8. Continue checking SSC and the relevant regional website for PET/PST or other subsequent-stage instructions.

SSC MTS Cut-Off 2026

SSC has released the cut-off information with the result. Candidates should note that there is not one universal MTS cut-off applicable to every candidate.

Under the official examination scheme, SSC can prescribe separate cut-offs based on factors including:

- Category

- State/UT

- MTS age group

- CCA for Havaldar

- Available vacancies

For MTS, separate age-group-wise, State/UT-wise and category-wise cut-offs can apply. For Havaldar, SSC can fix CCA-wise and category-wise cut-offs for shortlisting candidates for PET/PST.

Minimum Qualifying Marks

The official SSC MTS 2025 examination notice specifies the following minimum qualifying marks:

Category| Minimum Qualifying Marks

UR| 30%

OBC / EWS| 25%

All Other Categories| 20%

These are minimum qualifying standards, not the final selection cut-off. Actual cut-offs may be higher and vary according to the relevant State/UT/CCA, category and post.

SSC MTS Merit List 2026

For the MTS post, the official notification states that candidates are shortlisted on the basis of their performance in Session-II of the Computer-Based Examination. Normalized scores are used for determining merit.

The final consideration also depends on the candidate's post-cum-State/UT/CCA preferences and other provisions of the examination notice.

Candidates should therefore not interpret merely clearing the minimum qualifying percentage as confirmation of final selection.

SSC Havaldar Result 2026 and PET/PST

Candidates shortlisted for the Havaldar post have an additional selection requirement.

According to SSC's official examination notice, recruitment to Havaldar includes:

1. Computer-Based Examination

2. Physical Efficiency Test (PET)

3. Physical Standard Test (PST)

4. Final selection/allocation subject to the applicable SSC rules

Candidates who fail to qualify the prescribed PET/PST cannot be considered for the Havaldar post. Their candidature for MTS may, however, remain valid according to their CBE merit and the applicable provisions.

What Happens After SSC MTS Result 2026?

The next step depends on the post for which the candidate is being considered.

For Havaldar Candidates

Shortlisted candidates will have to appear for the PET/PST. Candidates should wait for the official schedule and instructions issued by SSC or the designated authority.

For MTS Candidates

Selection for MTS is governed by the normalized Session-II score, applicable cut-off, post-cum-State/UT/CCA preference, age group and available vacancies according to the examination rules.

Candidates must continue checking SSC notices because the CBE result should not automatically be treated as an appointment or joining order.

SSC MTS Scorecard and Marks 2026

Candidates should distinguish between the result PDF and their individual marks/score information.

SSC may separately make candidates' marks or related examination information available through its portal. Candidates should follow the specific official notice issued by SSC regarding the availability period and login procedure.

If the marks/scorecard link is not visible in a candidate's login, candidates should wait for the corresponding official SSC notice rather than relying on an unofficial download link.

Frequently Asked Questions

Is SSC MTS Result 2026 out?

Yes. The SSC MTS and Havaldar CBE result for the 2025 examination cycle was reported released on 3 August 2026. Candidates should verify their result through SSC's official portal.

Where can I check the SSC MTS Result 2026?

Candidates can check the result through the official Staff Selection Commission website at SSC's result section.

Is the SSC MTS Cut-Off 2026 released?

Yes. The cut-off information has been released with the result. The relevant cut-off varies according to the post and applicable category/State/UT/CCA/age-group parameters.

What are the minimum qualifying marks for SSC MTS 2025-26?

The official examination notice prescribes 30% for UR, 25% for OBC/EWS and 20% for all other categories. These percentages are minimum qualifying marks and should not be confused with the actual competitive cut-off.

What is the next stage after the SSC Havaldar Result?

Candidates shortlisted for Havaldar have to qualify the Physical Efficiency Test (PET) and Physical Standard Test (PST).

Is PET/PST required for SSC MTS candidates?

PET/PST applies to the Havaldar post. The official examination scheme does not prescribe the Havaldar PET/PST requirement for regular MTS selection.

Does qualifying the minimum percentage guarantee selection?

No. Candidates must also meet the applicable competitive cut-off and satisfy all other selection requirements. MTS cut-offs can differ by category, State/UT and age group, while Havaldar shortlisting can involve CCA-wise and category-wise cut-offs.

When will the Havaldar PET/PST be held?

Candidates should follow the subsequent official SSC/designated-authority notice for the confirmed PET/PST schedule. A date should not be assumed until officially announced.

Conclusion

The SSC MTS Havaldar Result 2026 is an important development for candidates who appeared in the February 2026 Computer-Based Examination. Candidates should download the official result/write-up, check the applicable cut-off carefully and keep their examination documents ready for subsequent stages.

Havaldar candidates shortlisted through the CBE should particularly monitor the official portal for PET/PST instructions.

For future Government Job notifications, Admit Cards, Results, Answer Keys and examination updates, readers can continue checking Free Career Notice along with the respective official recruitment portals.
